contexts.text: (Everything) is inscribed in his book of life, that is, his two memories and his nature...
This is his book of life which is opened in the other life... SE 2156.
Books in these passages = the recollection of all things which they have done, for everyone takes with him into the other life the memory of all his acts, thus the book of his life. Illustrated.
The interior or spiritual memory is the book of man's life. DP 227.
Under Book, see this reference, and at AR 867.
They who are written in the book of life = those who are in the life of truth and good, thus who, from love and faith, do the Divine commandments... Illustrated.
The Angels know all things of another's life from some ideas of his thought, because thence they know his reigning love, in which are all things in their order. Man's book of life is nothing else.

Man's book of life means that all things both done and thought are inscribed on the whole man, and appear as if read in a book when called forth from the memory, and as if seen in effigy when the spirit is viewed in the light of Heaven. Described.
The book of life () = the Word of the Lord, and all doctrine concerning Him.
Whose names were written in the book of life from the foundation of the world () = who do not believe in the Lord, and are not in doctrine from the Word.
If anyone was not found written in the book of life () = those who have not lived according to the Lord's injunctions in the Word.
But they who are written in the Lamb's book of life () = that none are received into the New Church... but those who believe in the Lord and live according to His injunctions in the Word.

To take away their part out of the book of life () = that they cannot acquire any wisdom from the Word, or appropriate anything from it. The book of life = the Word, and also the Lord as to the Word. References. The reason is that the Lord is the Word... TCR 107.
(Opening of man's book of life there.) SE 4701, Example(s).

I will not blot out his name out of the book of life () = that they will be in Heaven... The book of life = Heaven. Explained... The book of life is that with man which corresponds to Heaven with him. Explained, Illustrated.
